summary: NB Bancorp, Inc. (Nasdaq: NBBK), holding company for Needham Bank, filed a routine Form 8-K on October 15, 2026 reporting third-quarter 2026 results and declaring a quarterly cash dividend of $0.07 per share, payable November 12, 2026, to holders of record as of October 29, 2026. Q3 net income was $23.1 million, or $0.58 per diluted share, versus $21.1 million, or $0.53, prior quarter; ROAA 1.23% and ROAE 10.73%. No transaction, activist, or strategic event is disclosed; this is ordinary earnings and capital-return reporting with no deal terms.
